_about: Madeira events the Journal times a post for. Dates come from the official Visit Madeira tourist calendar 2026-2028 (checked 12 Oct 2026; the board says it can change). 'guide' = the post goes live this many days BEFORE 'start' (min to max): early enough to plan a trip, late enough that people still search. Add the next year's events here every autumn. The writer also confirms the dates with a web search before it writes.

events.name: Funchal Christmas lights and market
events.note: The Funchal amphitheatre lights run 1 Dec to 10 Jan. The Christmas market is expected from 28 Nov (not confirmed).
events.scene: Funchal bay at dusk with the Christmas lights shining on the hillside, seen from the sea

events.name: New Year's Eve fireworks over Funchal bay
events.note: Fireworks on 31 Dec over the bay. Famous worldwide; the bay is the best seat.
events.scene: Fireworks over Funchal bay at midnight seen from the water, a small boat in the foreground

events.name: Funchal Carnival 2027
events.note: 3 to 14 Feb. Allegorical parade 5 and 6 Feb, slapstick parade 9 Feb.
events.scene: Funchal seafront in February with colourful Carnival feathers and floats, no close faces

events.name: Madeira Flower Festival 2027
events.note: 29 Apr to 30 May. Great Flower Parade on 2 May and 16 May. Classic Car Revival 28 to 30 May.
events.scene: Flower carpets and flower floats in Funchal in spring, no close faces

events.name: Madeira Flower Parade, second Sunday (16 May 2027)
events.note: The second Great Flower Parade, 16 May.
events.scene: A flower float with orchids and bird of paradise on the Funchal avenue

events.name: Atlantic Festival 2027 (fireworks every Saturday in June)
events.note: 4 to 27 Jun. International fireworks competition on 5, 12, 19 and 26 Jun, shot over the bay.
events.scene: Fireworks competition over Funchal bay at night seen from a boat on the water
